_comment: Expected answers for tools/grade_answers.py, keyed by the exact question text in tools/manual-questions.txt
and tools/heldout-questions.txt. IDs follow docs/Manual-Test-Questions.md (not file line numbers); every figure
is sourced there. kind: figure (all 'expect' numbers, checked for 'unit'), fact (all 'expect' strings), negative
(a decline is correct), routing (a decline or the true figure passes; any other figure is wrong). unit:
million | thousand | $ (before the number) | % (after it) | null. accept: an alternative number that counts only
if the answer also names its own line (if_label). conflicts: lookalike figures - present together with the
expected one, the answer is flagged for a manual check. traps: nearby figures named in the report on a miss.
exact: the figure must be stated as printed - a rounded "$X.Y billion" doesn't count (A1-A27's MD&A rounding
traps and requested arithmetic; the user graded H34 the same way).
